material_class.structural_family: distorted cubane-like Y4(μ3-OH)4 core encapsulated by two α-[P2W15O56]12− Wells–Dawson units

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A tetranuclear [Y4(μ3-OH)4]8+ distorted cubane-like core is encapsulated between two trivacant α-[P2W15O56]12− polyoxotungstate units, which cap its top and bottom faces.

synthesis.ph: 0.1 M aqueous Na2CO3; pH not stated
synthesis.procedure: The α-[P2W15O56]12− polyoxoanion was reacted with YCl in aqueous 0.1 M Na2CO3, producing a slurry; compound 1 was isolated by recrystallization in 22.8% yield. Reagent quantities beyond the carbonate concentration were not stated.

reagents.name: sodium carbonate
reagents.role: aqueous reaction solution; hydrolysis reagent and buffer

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: A slurry formed; compound 1 was obtained after recrystallization.

material_class.structural_family: octahedral Yb6(μ6-O)(μ3-OH)6 core bridged by two α-[P2W15O56]12− Wells–Dawson units

measurements.conditions: Temperature-dependent magnetic susceptibility; low-temperature behavior discussed below 15 K.
measurements.name: intermolecular magnetic exchange parameter

properties.summary: Magnetic measurements indicate thermal depopulation within the ground multiplet from room temperature to 15 K; below 15 K, the behavior is attributed to intermolecular dipolar exchange between clusters.

source_locations.location: Synthesis and characterization section; CCDC catalog metadata

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two α-[P2W15O56]12− units bridge a hexanuclear ytterbium hydroxo/oxo cluster. Six YbIII ions form an octahedral arrangement around a central μ6-oxo atom; μ3-hydroxo groups bridge the metal centers, and the POM units link through terminal P=O groups at opposite faces.

synthesis.ph: 0.1 M aqueous Na2CO3; pH not stated
synthesis.procedure: The α-[P2W15O56]12− polyoxoanion was reacted with Yb(NO3)3 in aqueous 0.1 M Na2CO3, producing a slurry; compound 2 was isolated by recrystallization in 35.2% yield. Reagent quantities beyond the carbonate concentration were not stated.

reagents.name: sodium carbonate
reagents.role: aqueous reaction solution; hydrolysis reagent and buffer

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: A slurry formed; compound 2 was obtained after recrystallization.

title: Polyoxometalate-Supported Y– and YbIII–Hydroxo/Oxo Clusters from Carbonate-Assisted Hydrolysis
